description: Define a conversion to count, or change one you already defined. This is not one more setting: it is the numerator of every impact figure your human will read, so a goal that fires on every pageview makes the agent look brilliant and tells them nothing. Send `type` and `value` to create — idempotent, the same matcher twice creates one goal. Send `goalId` instead to rename, reprioritise or price an existing one, or with `remove: true` to stop counting it. Needs the goals permission.

dollarValue.description: Optional worth of one conversion, for revenue figures.

goalId.description: Change an EXISTING goal instead of creating one. Ids come from cromanion_config. With `remove: true` it stops counting that conversion; otherwise it applies the label, priority or dollarValue you send.

label.description: What your human will call it. Defaults to something readable.

priority.description: With goalId: 1 is the primary goal, ascending. Rejected rather than clamped if out of range.

remove.description: With goalId: stop counting that conversion. Nothing already measured is rewritten.

siteId.description: Which site this call is about. Only needed when your credential covers more than one — cromanion_grants lists them and says whether it is required. Omitting it with several is refused rather than guessed at.

type.description: Matcher: css_click, form_submit, page_view, mailto, tel, outbound, scroll_depth, dwell, custom_event.

value.description: What the matcher matches — a selector, a path, a percentage, seconds.

name: cromanion_add_goal

created.description: Present on a create. False when this site already counted that conversion — the call succeeded either way and nothing was duplicated.

label.description: What your human sees it called, after the change.

note.description: Present when nothing changed, saying why.

removed.description: Present when you sent remove: true.

updated.description: Present on an edit: which fields changed.
